hero.headline: We build software that
hero.description: mhsoftware crafts modern web and mobile applications — from idea to production. Clean code, great UX, and reliable delivery.

about.headline: A small studio with a big impact
about.p1: mhsoftware is an independent software studio focused on building high-quality digital products. We work closely with startups, scale-ups, and established businesses to turn ideas into reliable software.
about.p2: We believe great software comes from clear communication, solid engineering, and a genuine care for the end user. No bloat, no shortcuts — just work that lasts.

items.title: Web Development
items.description: Full-stack web apps built with modern frameworks like React, Next.js, and Node.js.
items.details: We design and build fast, scalable web applications from the ground up. Our stack includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. We cover everything from architecture and API design to deployment and performance optimization — delivering production-ready products that are easy to maintain and grow.

items.title: Mobile Apps
items.description: Cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for iOS and Android.
items.details: We build native-quality mobile apps with React Native, sharing code across iOS and Android while delivering a smooth, platform-appropriate experience. From push notifications and offline support to app store submission, we handle the full lifecycle.

items.title: Cloud & DevOps
items.description: Scalable infrastructure on AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
items.details: We design and manage cloud infrastructure that scales with your product. From setting up AWS environments and containerizing services with Docker to building automated CI/CD pipelines, we make sure your deployments are reliable, repeatable, and secure.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.description: Clean, accessible interfaces that users love — from wireframes to pixel-perfect code.
items.details: Good design is more than aesthetics — it's clarity, speed, and accessibility. We create interfaces grounded in user research and usability principles, then implement them with pixel-perfect precision. Every component is built with accessibility (WCAG) in mind.

items.title: API & Integrations
items.description: RESTful and GraphQL APIs, third-party integrations, and microservices architecture.
items.details: We build robust APIs that power your product and connect your systems. Whether you need a new backend from scratch, a GraphQL layer over existing data, or integrations with third-party services like Stripe, Twilio, or Salesforce, we deliver clean, well-documented solutions.

items.title: Consulting
items.description: Technical audits, architecture reviews, and hands-on guidance for your team.
items.details: Sometimes you need an experienced outside perspective. We offer technical audits, architecture reviews, and hands-on mentoring for engineering teams. Whether you're scaling a legacy system, evaluating a new technology, or preparing for a funding round, we help you make the right calls.
